ownership: Combat owns resurrection/revival validation, deterministic restoration ordering, and event emission. Character/NPC, inventory, corpse, room, status, persistence, and messaging owners commit requested mutations through sinks.
validated_requirements: eligibility flag and optional expiration tick
canonical target, source definition, room, and corpse references
bounded HP, mana, and energy restoration
combat_state: not restored; reentry remains a separate validated action
atomicity: all sinks prepare before any commit; committed sinks rollback in reverse order
unknowns: exact corpse and room requirements per spell or ability
safe_fallback: reject weak, missing, expired, or internally inconsistent resurrection policies before mutation
